examples.description: Remove an extra b-roll track together with its clips

description: Remove one track by track_id. A track that still holds clips is refused unless delete_clips is true, which removes its clips with it. Refuses, naming the fix: an unknown track_id, a locked track, a track with clips and no delete_clips, or the last track of its role (every project keeps one of each).

delete_clips.description: true removes the track's clips with it; left out, a track with clips is refused.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.
